content: ## Metadata_Start ## code: en ## title: Marketing Communication ## slug: marketing-communication ## seoTitle: ## description: ## contentType: Markdown ## Metadata_End Find tips & tricks below for better integrating Blackthorn {{variable.Product_Events}} with your Marketing Software. ## Using Pardot Automation Rules * Automation rules allow you to perform certain marketing and sales actions based on criteria that you specify. For example, you may want to suppress {{variable.Object_Attendee}}s that registered for an {{variable.Object_Event}} on a list for the reminder invitation. * You could use Pardot Automation Rules to remove Prospects once an {{variable.Object_Attendee}} registers and their {{variable.Object_CampaignMember}} {{variable.Field_CampaignMember_Status}} = "Responded". * [Here](https://www.salesforce.com/products/marketing-cloud/marketing-automation/?redirect=pardot.com#:~:text=Automation%20rules%20allow%20you%20to,your%20North%20American%20sales%20representative) is some documentation on Pardot Automation Rules.
